svg.title: Aquaculture farmer — Non-binary person
svg.desc: A fictional non-binary person working as aquaculture farmer, wearing a raincoat and a peaked work cap. Visible work cue: A circular floating fish pen has an elliptical rim, two hanging net divisions and a separate wavy waterline. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Occupational headgear: a peaked work cap.
